vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you have met or been near
vocabulary.example: The nurse called all of his contacts.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to find someone or something by following signs
vocabulary.example: The police traced the phone call.

vocabulary.meaning_en: having a disease that can spread
vocabulary.example: Infected people should stay at home.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the spirit of a dead person in stories
vocabulary.note_ar: كفعل (to ghost) = يتوقف فجأة عن الرد على شخص.
vocabulary.note_en: As a verb (to ghost) = suddenly stop replying to someone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to answer a message or question
a duty or job you must do
vocabulary.example: Paying the bills is my responsibility.
Ask a grown-up to help you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a flat dish you eat from
vocabulary.example: Put the plates on the table.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to turn round and round quickly

vocabulary.example: A crowd waited outside the stadium.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to get something from a place; the place it comes from
vocabulary.example: We source our fruit from local farms.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to collect money for a purpose
vocabulary.example: The school raised money for new books.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to tighten a muscle; (slang) to show off
vocabulary.example: He flexed his arm to show his muscles.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to try to make people admire you
vocabulary.example: Stop showing off your new shoes!
The company signed a big deal.

fine_lines.title: Ghosting vs left on read
fine_lines.explanation_ar: ghosting أن يقطع شخص التواصل معك تماماً وفجأة دون تفسير. left on read أن يقرأ رسالتك ولا يرد عليها (رسالة واحدة).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Ghosting = someone stops all contact suddenly with no explanation. 'Left on read' = someone reads one message but doesn't answer.

examples.sentence: My old classmate has been ghosting me for months.
I asked a question in the group and got left on read.

fine_lines.title: Flexing vs humblebrag
fine_lines.explanation_ar: flexing تباهٍ صريح بالمال أو الأغراض. humblebrag تباهٍ مخفي في كلام متواضع.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Flexing is openly showing off money or things. A humblebrag hides the showing off in modest words.

examples.sentence: He's flexing his new watch again.
'Ugh, my phone is too full of prize photos' - a humblebrag.

expressions.meaning_en: finding and contacting people who were near someone with an infectious disease
expressions.example: Contact tracing helped doctors stop the virus spreading.

expressions.meaning_ar: الاختفاء المفاجئ / قطع التواصل بلا تفسير
expressions.meaning_en: suddenly stopping all contact with someone without explaining why
expressions.example: The company interviewed me and then started ghosting me.

expressions.meaning_en: (informal, funny) doing boring grown-up jobs like paying bills
expressions.example: I paid my bills and cleaned the kitchen today - so much adulting!

expressions.phrase: have a lot of plates spinning
expressions.meaning_ar: تقوم بأعمال كثيرة في وقت واحد
expressions.meaning_en: to be dealing with many tasks at the same time
expressions.example: With work, study and family, I have a lot of plates spinning.

expressions.meaning_ar: التعهيد الجماعي (جمع أفكار أو مال من الناس)
expressions.meaning_en: getting ideas, help or money from a large number of people, usually online
expressions.example: We used crowdsourcing to choose the name of our new café.

expressions.phrase: laughing all the way to the bank
expressions.meaning_en: making a lot of money easily, especially when others thought you would fail
expressions.example: People laughed at her idea, but now she's laughing all the way to the bank.
He's always flexing his expensive trainers on social media.

expressions.meaning_en: said when someone suggests something better that you like
expressions.example: Pizza instead of salad? Now you're talking!

grammar.title: -ing words as nouns (gerunds)
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما نضيف ing- إلى الفعل يمكن أن يصبح اسماً يدل على النشاط: ghost → ghosting، crowdsource → crowdsourcing. ويمكن أن يكون فاعلاً في الجملة: Ghosting is unkind.
grammar.explanation_en: Add -ing to a verb and it can become a noun for the activity (a gerund): ghost → ghosting, crowdsource → crowdsourcing. It can be the subject: 'Ghosting is unkind.'

questions.question: Finding the people an ill person has met is called ___ .
questions.explanation_en: Contact tracing = finding the contacts of an infected person.

questions.question: My friend stopped answering all my messages with no reason. She is ___ me.
questions.explanation_ar: ghosting = قطع التواصل فجأة بلا تفسير.

questions.question: 'Adulting' means:
choices: doing grown-up jobs like paying bills

questions.question: 'She has a lot of plates spinning' means she:
choices: is doing many things at once
questions.explanation_ar: have a lot of plates spinning = تقوم بأعمال كثيرة معاً.
questions.explanation_en: It means doing many tasks at the same time.

questions.question: We asked thousands of people online to suggest ideas. This is ___ .
questions.explanation_ar: crowdsourcing = جمع الأفكار أو المال من عدد كبير من الناس.
questions.explanation_en: Crowdsourcing = getting ideas from many people.

questions.question: After selling his company, he's ___ .
choices: laughing all the way to the bank
questions.explanation_ar: laughing all the way to the bank = يربح الكثير بسهولة.
questions.explanation_en: It means making a lot of money easily.

questions.question: He posts photos of his expensive car every day. He's ___ .
'Let's go to the beach instead.' - '___ !'
questions.explanation_ar: Now you're talking = هذا اقتراح أفضل يعجبني.
questions.explanation_en: 'Now you're talking' = that's a better idea!

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: الاسم المنتهي بـ ing مفرد ويأخذ is.
questions.explanation_en: A gerund subject is singular: 'Ghosting is'.

questions.question: Which one is about money, not people or tasks?
choices: laughing all the way to the bank
questions.explanation_ar: laughing all the way to the bank يتعلق بكسب المال.
